experiment: E5 development: label-free base model variants (pilot train/validation only)
choice_rule_v1: lowest mean-over-seeds validation score max(median/1%, p95/3%) vs TSDT; ties to the earlier variant (P0 < P1 < P2 < P3)
choice_rule_v2: lowest validation score max(median/1%, p95/3%) vs TSDT of the downstream M-S correction built on the base, averaged over seeds and N = 10, 20, 40; ties to the earlier variant. Declared after rule v1 (physics-only score) chose P0, because rule v1 rewards a base whose approximation error happens to cancel the FSDT->TSDT bias, while the base is meant to reproduce FSDT and the correction handles FSDT->TSDT. No test data had been used. Rule v2 decides the base carried into confirmation.
